description: Gold test set for retrieval recall + answer faithfulness evaluation.

questions.question: How much does the Team edition cost per user per month?
What uptime SLA does the Enterprise edition offer?
Which encryption standard is used for data at rest?
questions.expected_answer: Data at rest is encrypted with AES-256.

questions.question: How long is the free trial and what edition does it cover?
questions.expected_answer: A 14-day free trial of the Team edition.

questions.question: How often is the primary database backed up?
questions.expected_answer: Every 6 hours, with backups retained for 30 days.

questions.question: What should the primary on-call acknowledge a page within?
Which data sources does Northwind natively support?
questions.expected_answer: PostgreSQL, MySQL, Snowflake, BigQuery, and Amazon S3, plus a generic REST connector.

questions.question: By how much did the Snowflake incremental refresh mode reduce refresh cost?
When will the legacy v1 REST API be removed?
What is the capital of France?
Can I get my money back if I cancel an annual contract?
questions.expected_answer: Annual Enterprise contracts may be refunded on a prorated basis within the first 30 days.

questions.question: Who should I contact about a security breach?
What do I do when dashboards are loading slowly?
questions.expected_answer: Check the query cache hit rate; a hit rate below 70% means a cache node needs restarting.
